shellCommands.command: (npm run start >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 3 && curl -s "http://localhost:3000/products/lamp?currency=EUR" -o /tmp/lamp-eur.html -w "%{http_code}\n" && grep -o "EUR [0-9.]*\|Loading product…\|Loading related products…\|Stone vase\|Signal Shop collection" /tmp/lamp-eur.html | sort | uniq -c

for url in "products/lamp" "products/lamp?currency=EUR" "products/lamp?currency=USD" "products/vase?currency=EUR"; do echo -n "$url -> "; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/$url" | grep -o "USD [0-9.]*\|EUR [0-9.]*" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing product status: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3000/products/nope"
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/products/nope" | grep -c "404\|This page could not be found\|NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK"; kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; true
